title: AriKeys Continued
description: Fork of AriKeys for moden versions. AriKeys is a client-side mod for Minecraft, which allows your client to receive and send keypresses between servers using the AriKeys plugin.
body:
## About this fork

This repository is a fork of the original [ASangarin/AriKeys](https://modrinth.com/mod/arikeys) project.
It is maintained only to keep AriKeys working on newer Minecraft versions. No new features are planned or accepted.

The PayPal link belongs to and supports the original author, ASangarin.

## Installation:
- **Fabric**
1. Install [Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/)
2. Download [Fabric API](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fabric-api) and put it in your mods folder.
3. Download [AriKeys](https://github.com/Darwin1546/AriKeys/releases) (Fabric) and put it in your mods folder

- **NeoForge** *(MC 1.20.4 and above)*
1. Install [NeoForge](https://projects.neoforged.net/neoforged/neoforge)
2. Download [AriKeys](https://github.com/Darwin1546/AriKeys/releases) (NeoForge) and put it in your mods folder

- **Minecraft 1.21.3 and below**

Check the [original project](https://modrinth.com/mod/arikeys).

## Usage:
AriKeys must be used alongside a server running the [AriKeysPlugin](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/arikeysplugin-custom-keybinds.105968/)
When joining such a server, it will send the configured keybinds to your client and you will be able to see and change keybindings from the game menu.

![AriKeys Button](https://i.imgur.com/bUypgi1.png)

## Support
For issues caused by updating AriKeys to a newer Minecraft version, open an issue in this repository.
Feature requests are outside the scope of this fork.

For the original project and its community, see [ASangarin/AriKeys](https://github.com/ASangarin/AriKeys) or the original author's [Support Discord](https://discord.gg/bPkStPTmNK).
